alreadyTested.policy: ALREADY_TESTED features keep their sealed study references and are never re-run; those computed here enter Level 2 only as baselines or controls

primaryFrozenSnapshot: PHASE_B_GIT_PINNED_PROXY_SNAPSHOT: exact inputs identity 3e4d7aa35e2c4b273e4ecef0e2e8ea7a8a27077f0de14bb3d5ea6a696a97f1a5; original Actions official market bytes are not selected
proxyLimitation: Close times volume is not official ACC_TRDVAL. Capacity is a proxy-based research assumption, never a measured intraday execution claim.

targets.gross: Close[exit]/Close[entry]-1; replay split-continuous dividend-forward accumulated index, not complete shareholder total return
targets.benchmarkRelative: gross-stock minus gross-069500.KS on identical sessions
targets.industryRelative: stock minus signal-cap-weighted leave-one-out industry; >=5 classified members, all peers valid, no renormalization over missing outcomes
targets.modelTarget: within-date demeaned benchmarkRelative; common valid outcome mask; benchmark same-date intercept cannot affect ordering

chronology.purge: target exit strictly before training cutoff
chronology.cutoff: 21 KR sessions before first registered weekly signal of evaluation year

preprocessing.percentiles: within full signal-date measured cross-section; average ties; fixed before validity gates
preprocessing.imputation: training-only date-balanced median percentile; all-missing training column inactive at evaluation
preprocessing.missingIndicators: one per registered feature, always present; no missing target imputation
preprocessing.scaling: training-only date-balanced mean and population SD; zero variance column scaled by 1
preprocessing.evaluationMask: common outcome-valid rows, >=one measured B4 column; augmented model cannot select a different population

linearModel.objective: weighted mean squared error + penalty * sum(beta^2); intercept unpenalized
linearModel.dateWeight: each training date weight 1/nDates; each eligible row 1/nNamesOnDate

level1.calibratedGate: primary calibrated SN lower bound >0 in addition to BY q<=0.10
level1.binaryEventGroups: J01 uses its frozen0/1 values for raw/within-industry groups, not arbitrary tied percentile cuts
level1.halves: both direction-oriented spread estimates strictly positive

level2.redundancy: training-only within-date Spearman, equal mean across dates with >=30 paired names; absolute rho>=0.8 connected components
level2.primaryP: max(two two-sided calendar-time SN p-values); both estimates must be positive
level2.residualization: per signal date OLS projection of candidate percentile on B4 percentiles/indicators, without outcomes; slope with same B4 controls
level2.conditionalSlopes: date OLS with B4 controls and fixed 0.5 imputation/indicators; non-identifiable candidate slope withheld; outcomes common-mask only
level2.residualGate: at least52 dates and80% scheduled share with positive oriented residual spread; exact/numerical B4 duplication cannot piggyback a family increment; no extra significance claim
level2.conditionalSlopeErrors: Newey-West lag ceil(H/5)-1 on date slopes; DESCRIPTIVE, never gates
level2.identicalPredictions: qualified identical common-sample forecasts are structurally REDUNDANT; zero self-normalizer is not claimed significant
level2.commonSample: one validity mask and identical row identities for paired metrics, no complete-case comparison

terminalPolicy.uniformEvidenceRule: all securities evaluated identically from own completeness evidence, never a future-termination flag
terminalPolicy.knownBasisGap: withhold every observation whose security has unresolved audited distribution basis; unknown unaudited basis explicitly qualified
terminalPolicy.unknownConsideration: invalid window, NEVER zero payoff, last-price exit, successor guess or unilateral model exclusion
terminalPolicy.resolvedExchange: requires cited cash/stock consideration and full successor distribution-adjusted path; unavailable pinned chain blocks
terminalPolicy.portfolioRule: select on signal information BEFORE label mask; any selected or reference constituent unpriceable blocks the whole paired portfolio comparison
terminalPolicy.statisticalRule: symmetric valid-name mask; qualified surviving-sample development associations allowed; no unconditional delisting-risk claim

conditionalPolicies.X1: cheap B05 top tercile AND b08Confirmed=1; rank B05
conditionalPolicies.X2: A05 top tercile AND D05 bottom tercile; rank A05
conditionalPolicies.X5: F01 bottom tercile AND E01 bottom tercile (liquid); rank negative F01
conditionalPolicies.forecast: existing FULL H126, no new fitted model
conditionalPolicies.trigger: interaction Holm passes AND any previously untested component passes primary Levels1/2/residual/stability gates
conditionalPolicies.X3: control-only components: earlier untested-component gate unavailable; conditional economics NOT_TRIGGERED

economics.basket: equal-weight direction-oriented top tercile, diagnostic only
economics.entryRule: positive OOF date-centered forecast greater than stock+fallback round-trip costs, top oriented tercile and signal tradable/capacity gates
economics.exAnteCosts: entry eligibility uses signal-date tax and fees only; realized exit uses exit-date effective tax, never future tax information for selection
economics.capitalEvolution: initial capital compounded by prior valid net block returns; unpriceable prior NAV blocks every later block, no fixed-capital capacity fiction
economics.feeFinancing: 20% slots are cash budgets inclusive of entry fees; executed asset weight=budget/(1+entry fee), including passive fallback and reference; no borrowing
economics.pairedPolicies: identical predetermined anchors; any unpriceable policy blocks the joint policy comparison; valid isolated diagnostics retain explicit boundaries
economics.rebalance: nonoverlapping H-session blocks anchored to first registered evaluation signal within feature usable range, no data-dependent rescheduling
economics.roundTrips: fully liquidate every registered block, charge dated entry and exit, no leverage or optimizer
economics.liquidity: ALL/HIGH/LOW in both diagnostic and slot policies, both fallbacks; only ALL/HIGH gate; top/bottom halves of signal-date E03; E03 only capacity, E01 only alpha; never double count cost savings
economics.attributionIdentity: gross=A+B+C+F+G; net adds E; D is a descriptive nested explanation of C, not a second additive credit
economics.riskExposure: descriptive block excess and C regressions on B4 columns plus registered F01 factor-mimicking rank spreads; intercepts cannot establish alpha
economics.support: net top basket excess positive in both fallbacks and high liquidity half; slot stock-selection positive; reconciled benchmark required

benchmarkIntegrity.externalCheck: authoritative definition-compatible same-session annual total return differences <=0.005 in every year
benchmarkIntegrity.frozenDecision: no compatible external input pinned: absolute economic claims blocked for this run; rankings and within-date contrasts retained

decision.level4Trigger: primary family horizon Level1 BY passes + stability + Level2 ADD family Holm passes; interactions also need Holm and controls
decision.supportMeaning: independent of simpler factors in DEVELOPMENT, never independent confirmation or promotion

sourceLimitations: EVERY KOREAN DATE IS OUTCOME-EXPOSED DEVELOPMENT HISTORY (through 2026-09-14): whatever Phase C finds is EXPLORATORY_DEVELOPMENT_ON_OUTCOME_EXPOSED_KR_HISTORY, never confirmation

UNIVERSE: the PIT Top120 by monthly KRX market-cap snapshot strictly older than the signal date; the 22 securities that terminated inside it have unresolved terminal economics, so a label for a held terminating name cannot be valued (the Phase C registration must declare how it is withheld)

INDUSTRY LABELS ARE RECONSTRUCTED (PIT_RECONSTRUCTED_MEMBERSHIP): current KRX/KIND anchors plus verified change events, not vendor-historical labels; 22 terminated names are unclassified; an industry cohort needs >= 5 classified members

PRICE PANEL: replay-v16 closes are split-continuous and dividend-forward-accumulated, built with the listed-share count's LATER confirmation of each split; windows touching a split not confirmed at the signal date are masked here, but the panel is not itself a signal-date reproduction

TRADED VALUE IS A PROXY (as-traded close x volume) because the official KRX ACC_TRDVAL exists only in the preserved raw-input artifact; the difference (closing price against the session's volume-weighted price) was not measured

DART ACCOUNTING IS DARK 2013-2015 and mostly 2016 (DART serves from 2015 and the TTM roll-forward needs prior-year quarters), covers 250 collected tickers, and financials rarely state revenue or operating income, which is why margin, cash-conversion and capex-intensity features sit below the floor

DART ACCOUNTING VISIBILITY: a filing is visible on the day AFTER its receipt date; a restatement arrives as its own filing; an amendment served in place of an original (27.6% of the sealed store by an earlier audit) is PIT-honest and costs coverage
BENCHMARK 069500.KS is reproducible but its external reconciliation is unresolved (BENCHMARK_EXTERNAL_RECONCILIATION_UNRESOLVED); no corrected benchmark was built and none was changed
THE READINESS THRESHOLDS ARE GATES, NOT TESTS: 60% coverage and 30 names per date are inherited; 52 evaluable dates and 3 names per 2x2 corner are introduced here and stated as such
untestedQuestion: Inflation/growth-conditioned CPI or labor-market sign reversals: untested, PIT macro unavailable; prospective or later US program only. X6 is market trend/volatility.
